# Best CPA Colorado

> Colorado CPA, tax preparation, bookkeeping and IRS tax resolution information for individuals and small businesses statewide.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.bestcpacolorado.com/): Colorado CPA help for taxes, bookkeeping, back taxes and IRS letters. Statewide, fast to reach, and built for business owners who are tired of the stress.
- [Tax Preparation](https://www.bestcpacolorado.com/tax-preparation/): Colorado tax preparation for individuals and businesses: federal and state returns, extensions, amended returns and multi-state filings, done right.
- [Bookkeeping Services](https://www.bestcpacolorado.com/bookkeeping-services/): Monthly bookkeeping services for Colorado small businesses: reconciliations, clean financial statements and tax-ready books in QuickBooks, Xero and more.
- [IRS Tax Help](https://www.bestcpacolorado.com/irs-tax-resolution/): Owe back taxes or got an IRS letter? Colorado help with unfiled returns, notices, payment plans, penalty relief and Colorado Department of Revenue debts.
- [Small Business Accounting](https://www.bestcpacolorado.com/small-business-accounting/): Small business accounting in Colorado: LLC and S-corp decisions, payroll, sales tax across home-rule cities, quarterly estimates and year-round planning.
- [Catch-Up Bookkeeping](https://www.bestcpacolorado.com/catch-up-bookkeeping/): Behind on your books? Catch-up bookkeeping for Colorado businesses rebuilds missing months or years so you can file, borrow and sleep again. Take the free check.
- [Colorado Business Tax Guide](https://www.bestcpacolorado.com/colorado-tax-guide/): A plain-English guide to Colorado business taxes: state income tax, layered sales tax, home-rule cities, SUTS, FAMLI, occupational privilege taxes and TABOR refunds.
- [Colorado Cities](https://www.bestcpacolorado.com/colorado-cities/): CPA, tax and bookkeeping help across Colorado: Colorado Springs, Aurora, Fort Collins, Boulder, Lakewood, Greeley, Pueblo, Grand Junction and more.
- [AI Front Office](https://www.bestcpacolorado.com/ai-automation/): The AI front office built into this site: a 24/7 assistant that qualifies tax leads, books consults, sends document checklists and triggers firm workflows.
- [FAQ](https://www.bestcpacolorado.com/faq/): Answers to common Colorado tax questions: deadlines, choosing a CPA, back taxes, payment plans, record keeping, TABOR refunds and more.
- [For CPA Firms](https://www.bestcpacolorado.com/claim-this-site/): bestcpacolorado.com is available to one Colorado CPA or bookkeeping firm: a custom-coded, SEO, AIO and AI-agent ready site built to win clients statewide.
- [Site Map](https://www.bestcpacolorado.com/sitemap/): Every page on Best CPA Colorado.

## Facts
- Coverage: all of Colorado, including Colorado Springs, Aurora, Fort Collins, Boulder, Greeley, Pueblo and Grand Junction.
- Colorado individual returns follow the federal deadline (usually April 15) with an automatic six-month extension to file, not to pay.
- Colorado state sales tax rate: 2.9%, plus local and home-rule city taxes.
- Denver companion resource: https://www.bestdenveraccountant.com/
